lead: The element uses the first two images and takes each caption from the file’s title. They sit side by side by default; the reveal style lays one over the other.

images.alternative: A bakery shopfront with peeling blue paint and a stained awning, before the refit.
images.title: Before — March

images.alternative: The same bakery shopfront after the refit, freshly painted and with a new cream awning.
images.title: After — September

caption: The same shopfront in March and in September, photographed from the same spot.
note: In the reveal style the boundary starts in the middle, so both states show before anyone moves it. On phones the two pictures stack instead.
